title: GERA-TRACK: Geriatric Range Tracking Study: changes in functional parameters during comprehensive geriatric care - a longitudinal observational study at the Evangelical Hospital Cologne Weyertal
summary: The GERA-TRACK study examines how the health and functional status of older patients changes during a stay in an inpatient geriatric unit. To this end, the study uses information routinely collected in the hospital, such as data on mobility, independence, memory, nutrition, and social factors. In addition, after discharge, patients are contacted by phone to find out how they are doing at home and whether their health has changed further. The goal of the study is to identify which factors are particularly important for treatment success and which patients benefit most from comprehensive geriatric care. The results are intended to help further improve care for older adults and better tailor treatment to individual needs.
conditions: The study examines frailty, multimorbidity, and functional limitations in older patients during inpatient geriatric comprehensive care. The goal is to identify functional trajectories and prognostic factors in order to improve care for older adults.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Admission for comprehensive geriatric care at the Evangelisches Klinikum Weyertal
Retrospective: Availability of complete routine data on admission and discharge
Prospective: Written consent to participate
Exclusion criteria:
Objection to the Use of Clinical Data
Prospective: Withdrawal of Consent
